exactBookRule: SPELLBOOK. At Wizard 1 your spellbook contains six chosen rank-1 Wizard spells. Arcane School Specialization also adds one legal rank-1 bonus spell of your chosen school without replacing one of those six. For this provisional progression, add 2 legal Wizard spells to the book at each Wizard level 2-4, 3 at each level 5-8, 4 at each level 9-12, 5 at each level 13-16 and 6 at each level 17-20. Level-up additions cost no money or scribing time.
exactLegalRankRule: LEGAL RANKS. Maximum Wizard spell rank by Wizard class level is: rank 1 at levels 1-2, rank 2 at 3-4, rank 3 at 5-6, rank 4 at 7-8, rank 5 at 9-10, rank 6 at 11-12, rank 7 at 13-14, rank 8 at 15-16 and rank 9 at 17-20. Grand Tier at level 20 is a special casting permission, not a tenth ordinary rank. A Wizard may learn Wizard-list spells from any school up to the legal rank unless a spell itself has an additional prerequisite.
exactPreparedRule: PREPARED SPELL MATRIX. After a long rest, prepare a number of matrices equal to Wizard level + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1, selecting only spells currently recorded in your spellbook and within your legal rank. You cast ordinary Wizard spells only from prepared matrices unless a feature explicitly overrides that restriction. Preparing the full daily matrix set normally requires 1 hour of spellbook study. Matrix Efficiency reduces this to 45 minutes.

Each addition must be legal at its actual acquisition level, not only at final class level. Later scribing requires its own real legal time/materials/availability.

A level17Wizard has67 cumulative free entries but only6 acquired-at-rank9-level slots. A10-spell rank9 cohort is not automatically one level17 book; use separately valid fixture builds, actual later levels or actual sourced scribing.
Prepared capacity is not all spells in the book. Class-card always-prepared matrices are separately acquired and do not grant arbitrary ordinary spells.
